source_string: Resource packs are applied bottom to top. This means any asset that is in two packs will be overridden by the higher pack. Packs in your worlds will apply on top of these global packs. These resources are just for you. No one else will see the resources you set here. Resource Packs in your worlds or worlds you join will apply on top of these global resources.

source_string: Behavior Packs are applied bottom to top. That means anything that is in two Behavior Packs will be overridden by the higher one.

source_string: Resource packs are applied bottom to top. This means any asset that is in two packs will be overridden by the higher pack. These packs in your world apply on top of your global pack(s).
translation: Resurs töplamlari pastdan yuqoriga qarab qöllanadi. Bu şuni anglatadiki, agar bir xil resurs ikki töplamda bölsa, yuqorida turgan paket uning örnini egallaydi. Olamingizdagi uşbu töplamlar global töplamlaringiz ustidan qöllanadi.

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Temir golem siz tomonda turib jang qiladi!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Börini xonakilaştiriş uçun unga suyak bering. Şundan söng uni ötirğizib qöyişingiz yoki orqangizdan ergaştirişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Boşingizga qovoq kiyib olsangiz, Endermenlar sizga hujum qilmaydi.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Sigirlardan çarm olib, undan sovut va kitoblar yasaşda foydalaning.

source_string: You can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.
translation: Böş çelakni suv, lava, sut, yumşoq qor... va hatto ba'zi moblar bilan töldirişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Hayvonlarga ovqat bersangiz, ular yöqolib ketmaydi. Ularni xavfsiz saqlaş uçun katak yoki ğov yasang.

source_string: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!
translation: Vagonetka va relslar yordamida manzilingizga tezroq yetib oling!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension called the Nether.
translation: Portal quriş sizga boşqa olam — Netherga yöl oçadi.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Suyak uni (skelet suyagidan yasaladi) öğit sifatida işlatiladi va ekinlarni bir zumda östiradi!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidian — suv lava manbaiga tuşganda hosil böladi.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Suv yoki lavaning manba bloki olib taşlansa, uning oqişi butunlay töxtaydi.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.
translation: Yoruğlik manbai bölgan bloklar qor va muzni eritadi. Bunga maş'allar, yorqintoşlar va jek çiroqlari kiradi.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Oçiq havoda jundan inşootlar qurişda ehtiyot böling — çaqmoq urib, junni yoqib yuborişi mumkin.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Bitta lava çelagi bilan peçda 100 ta blokni eritiş mumkin.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: Nota bloki çiqaradigan çolğu ovozi uning ostidagi blok turiga boğliq.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.
translation: Bitta böriga qöl kötarsangiz, atrofida bölgan barça börilar duşmanga aylanadi.

source_string: Wolves and iron golems won't attack creepers.
translation: Börilar va temir golemlar creeper'larga hujum qilişmaydi.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Tovuqlar har 5–10 daqiqada bittadan tuxum qöyadi.

source_string: Obsidian can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidianni faqat olmos çökiç bilan qazib oliş mumkin.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creeper'lar — porox olişning eng oson yöli.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Xonakilaştirilgan börilarning qança joni qolganini dumining joylaşuvidan bilib olsa böladi. Ularni davolaş uçun göşt bering.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Har xil rangli böyoqlarni turli xil manbalardan oliş mumkin. Yaşil böyoqni oliş uçun peçda kaktusni pişiring!

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become zombified piglins.
translation: Çaqmoq urgan çöçqalar zombilangan piglinlarga aylanadi.

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Ba'zan temir golemlar qişloqlik bolalariga gul sovğa qilişadi!
Otselotlar creeper'larga kim bu yerda xöjayin ekanligini körsatib qöyişadi!

source_string: Use seagrass to attract and breed sea turtles.
translation: Dengiz toşbaqalarini özingizga jalb qiliş va köpaytiriş uçun dengiz ötlaridan foydalaning.

source_string: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
translation: Mitti toşbaqalarni yovuz moblardan himoya qiling!

source_string: Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
translation: Mitti toşbaqalar ösib ulğayganida ulardan qalqonçalar tuşadi — ulardan toşbaqa qobiğini yasaş mumkin.

source_string: Brew some water breathing potions for underwater exploration!
translation: Suv ostida keziş uçun suv ostida nafas oliş damlamasini tayyorlab oling!

source_string: Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
translation: Delfinlar sizni çökkan kemalar va suv osti xarobalariga yetaklab borişi mumkin, ularga treska bering va orqalaridan ergaşing!

source_string: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
There are 3587 types of tropical fish!
Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
translation: Dengiz bodringlarini peçda pişirib, oç yaşil böyoq olişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
translation: Lamalarni köpaytiriş uçun piçan toyidan foydalaning!

source_string: Compasses always point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way!
translation: Kompas har doim dunyoning paydo böliş (spavn) nuqtasini körsatadi — yölingizni yöqotmaslik uçun bittasini yasab oling!

source_string: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools, and even explorer maps!
translation: Qişloqliklar bilan savdo qilib, yegulik, qurollar va hatto tadqiqotçi xaritalarini qölga kiriting!

source_string: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
translation: Xaritaning ikkinçi qölingizda ham tutib turişingiz mumkinligini bilarmidingiz?

source_string: Leads can be used on boats.
translation: Arqondan qayiq uçun ham foydalanişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Sneak to walk safely on magma blocks.
translation: Magma bloklari ustida şikastlanmasdan yuriş uçun egilib harakatlaning.

source_string: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
translation: Örgimçak törlarini qayçi yordamida yiğib olişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
translation: Sançqilar çökkanlardan tuşadi, ularni qölda tutiş yoki otiş mumkin.

source_string: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
translation: Peçda bir blok quritilgan laminariyadan yoqilği sifatida foydalanib, 20 ta buyumni eritişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
translation: Skelet-otni xonakilaştiriş uçun egarga hojat yöq.

source_string: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
translation: Fantomlar — tunda paydo böladigan xavfli moblardir. Vaqti‑vaqti bilan uxlab turişni unutmang!

source_string: Zombies turn into drowned if they sink underwater.
translation: Zombi suv ostiga çöksa, çökkanga aylanib qoladi.
Suziş uçun suvda yuguriş tugmasini bosing!

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Tepaga qarab qaziyotganingizda, qulab tuşişi mumkin bölgan qum yoki şağalni birdan yöq qiliş uçun oyoq ostingizga maş'al qöying.

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
translation: Asalari uyasi yoki arixonadan mum oliş uçun qayçidan, asal oliş uçun esa şişa idişdan foydalaning.

source_string: Place a campfire under a beehive or nest to harvest honey.
translation: Asalni xavfsiz yiğib oliş uçun arixona yoki asalari uyasi ostiga gulxan yoqing.

source_string: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows.
translation: Zumrad ma'dani — Minecraft'dagi eng kamyob rudadir! Ularni faqat toğlar va ötloqlardan topiş mumkin.

source_string: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
translation: Olmoslar kerakmi? Qançalik çuqurroq tuşsangiz, ularni topiş imkoniyati şunçalik ortadi.

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Baqalar kiçik va kub şaklidagi moblarni yeydi.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: Yuvoşlar buyumlarni töplaşni juda yaxşi köradi! Agar unga biror buyum bersangiz, u öşa buyumdan köproq topib kelişga harakat qiladi.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Itbaliq ösib ulğaygan biomning haroratiga qarab öz turini tanlaydi.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Qadimiy şaharlarni toğ tizmalari ostidan topişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with noteblocks!
translation: Yuvoşlar musiqani juda yoqtirişgani uçun nota bloklari bilan bajonidil öynaşişadi!

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Loy oliş uçun tuproq blokiga suv şişasini işlating!

source_string: When wandering in the deep dark, silence is key.
translation: Zulmat qa'rida kezganda, sukunat — eng muhim qoida.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Qölingizda buğdoy uşlab tursangiz, ba'zi hayvonlar orqangizdan ergaşib yuradi.

source_string: Before you mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure you're using an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.
translation: Olmos, redstone yoki oltin qazib oliş uçun temir yoki olmos çökiçdan foydalaning, aks holda ular tuşmaydi.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Ikkita sandiqni yonma‑yon qöyib ularni bitta katta sandiqqa aylantirsa böladi.

source_string: Can't find any coal for your torches? Try putting some logs in a furnace.
translation: Maş'al uçun kömir topa olmayapsizmi? Peçga bir neçta yoğoç solib köring.

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Köçatlarni eking, ular tez orada daraxt bölib ösib çiqadi.

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Ekin ekiş uçun yer maydonini tayyorlaşda ketmondan foydalaning.

translation: Özini boşqa birov qilib körsatiş yoki boşqalarni aldaş va ulardan foydalaniş maqsadida ma'lumot tarqatiş

translation: Real hayotdagi haddan taşqari zöravonlik yoki şafqatsizlik tasvirlari

translation: Kontentni firibgarlik yöli bilan qölga kiritiş yoki undan foydalaniş

translation: Kimgadir qaratilgan haqoratlar va kamsituvçi sözlar

source_string: Intent to cause real-life harm to persons or property
translation: Şaxslarga yoki mulkka real hayotda zarar yetkaziş niyati

Topics or content of a sexual nature
References to hate groups, terrorist organizations, or notorious figures
translation: Nafrat guruhlari, terroristik taşkilotlar yoki yomon nom çiqargan şaxslarga işora

source_string: Topics or content of a sexual nature
Value entered empty or lower than 0. Respawn radius is reset to default value 5.
translation: Kiritilgan qiymat böş yoki 0 dan kiçik. Qayta tiriliş radiusi birlamçi 5 qiymatiga tiklandi.

source_string: Value entered is too high. Respawn radius is reset to maximum value 128.
translation: Kiritilgan qiymat juda yuqori. Qayta tiriliş radiusi maksimal 128 qiymatiga örnatildi.

source_string: Respawn within this block radius when you die and no custom spawnpoint is set (max 128)
translation: Ölsangiz va maxsus paydo böliş nuqtasi örnatilmagan bölsa, uşbu blok radiusi içida qayta tirilasiz (maks. 128)

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn but deal less damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to 5 hearts.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo böladi, biroq kamroq zarar yetkazadi. Oçlik darajasi pasayib boradi va soğliqni 5 ta yurak qolgunça kamaytiradi.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn and deal more damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains all health.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo böladi va köproq zarar yetkazadi. Oçlik darajasi pasayib boradi va butun soğliqni tugatadi.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn and deal standard damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to half a heart.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo böladi va odatiy darajada zarar yetkazadi. Oçlik darajasi pasayib boradi va soğliqni yarimta yurak qolgunça kamaytiradi.

source_string: No hostile mobs and only some neutral mobs spawn. Hunger bar doesn't deplete and health replenishes over time.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo bölmaydi, faqat ba'zi neytral moblarnigina uçratiş mumkin. Oçiqlik darajasi pasaymaydi, soğliq esa vaqt ötişi bilan qayta tiklanadi.

source_string: You get to set your own rules through in-game commands on how you and other can interact with the game.
translation: Öyindagi buyruqlar yordamida özingiz va boşqalar uçun öyin qoidalarini özingiz örnatişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Create, build, and explore without limits. You can fly, have endless materials, and can't be hurt by monsters.
translation: Çeksiz imkoniyatlar bilan yarating, quring va dunyoni kaşf eting. Siz uça olasiz, resurslaringiz tugamaydi va maxluqlar sizga zarar yetkaza olmaydi.

source_string: Explore a mysterious world where you build, collect, craft, and fight monsters.
translation: Quring, resusrlarni töplang, narsalar yasang va maxluqlarga qarşi kuraşib, sirli dunyoni kaşf eting.

source_string: You can't respawn if you die. Good luck! You'll need it.
translation: Ölsangiz, qayta tirila olmaysiz. Omad yor bölsin! U sizga juda kerak böladi.

source_string: Your world settings will not be saved if you leave.
Global packs are applied to all of your worlds. They are deactivated when “Shared local packs” is turned on.
translation: Global töplamlar barça olamlaringizga qöllaniladi. “Lokal töplamlarni ulaşiş” yoqilgan bölsa ular öçiriladi.

translation: Quring, resusrlarni töplang, narsalar yasang va maxluqlarga qarşi kuraşib, sirli dunyoni kaşf eting.

source_string: Impersonation or sharing information to exploit or mislead others
translation: Özini boşqa birov qilib körsatiş yoki boşqalarni aldaş va ulardan foydalaniş maqsadida ma'lumot tarqatiş

source_string: Depictions of real-life excessive violence or gore
translation: Real hayotdagi haddan taşqari zöravonlik yoki şafqatsizlik tasvirlari

source_string: Fraudulent acquisition or use of content
translation: Kontentni firibgarlik yöli bilan qölga kiritiş yoki undan foydalaniş

source_string: Abusive language used in a directed, harmful manner
translation: Kimgadir qaratilgan haqoratlar va kamsituvçi sözlar

source_string: Intent to cause real-life harm to persons or property
translation: Şaxslarga yoki mulkka real hayotda zarar yetkaziş niyati

translation: Nafrat guruhlari, terroristik taşkilotlar yoki yomon nom çiqargan şaxslarga işora

source_string: Caution: Online play is offered by third-party servers that are not owned, operated, or supervised by Mojang Studios or Microsoft. During online play, you may be exposed to unmoderated chat messages or other types of user-generated content that may not be suitable for everyone.
translation: Diqqat: onlayn öyinlar Mojang Studios yoki Microsoft kompaniyalariga tegişli bölmagan, ular tomonidan boşqarilmaydigan va nazorat qilinmaydigan taşqi serverlar tomonidan taqdim etiladi. Onlayn öyin jarayonida sizga moderatorlar tomonidan tekşirilmagan çat xabarlari yoki hammaga ham töğri kelmaydigan boşqa turdagi foydalanuvçi kontentlariga duç kelişi mumkin.

source_string: By submitting this report, you confirm that the information you have provided is accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge.
translation: Şikoyat yuboriş orqali siz taqdim etgan ma'lumotlar aniq va töliq ekanligini tasdiqlaysiz.
Öziga zarar yetkaziş yoki öz joniga qasd qiliş
Bolalarga nisbatan şafqatsizlik yoki jinsiy ekspluatatsiya
Boşqalarga zarar yetkaziş bilan tahdid qiliş

source_string: Sign in or sign up for free to start earning achievements.
translation: Yutuqlarga erişişni boşlaş uçun tizimga kiring yoki röyxatdan öting.

source_string: You can change the look of your character with a Skin Pack from the Store. Select 'Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.
translation: Qahramoningiz körinişini dökondagi skinlar töplami orqali özgartirişingiz mumkin. Mavjud skinlar töplamlarini köriş uçun Asosiy menyuda "Dökon" bölimini tanlang.

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Temir golem siz tomonda turib jang qiladi!

source_string: Alter the brightness setting to make the game brighter or darker.
translation: Öyinni yorqinroq yoki qoronğiroq qiliş uçun yorqinlik sozlamalarini özgartiring.

source_string: If you set the game difficulty to Peaceful, your health will automatically regenerate, and no monsters will come out at night!
translation: Öyin qiyinligini "Tinç" rejimiga qöysangiz, joningiz avtomatik ravişda tiklanadi va tunda maxluqlar paydo bölmaydi!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Börini xonakilaştiriş uçun unga suyak bering. Şundan söng uni ötirğizib qöyişingiz yoki orqangizdan ergaştirişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Boşingizga qovoq kiyib olsangiz, Endermenlar sizga hujum qilmaydi.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.
translation: Karavotda yotsangiz, tun bir zumda ötib ketadi. Lekin tarmoqli öyinda buning uçun hamma öyinçilar bir vaqtda uxlaşlari şart.

source_string: Harvest food from pigs, cows, sheep, rabbit, and chickens. Cook and eat it to regain health!
translation: Sigir, qöy, quyon va tovuqlardan göşt oling. Soğliqni tiklaş uçun ularni pişirib yeng!

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Sigirlardan çarm olib, undan sovut va kitoblar yasaşda foydalaning.

source_string: If you have an empty bucket, you can fill it with water, lava, or milk from a cow!
translation: Böş çelak bölsa, uni suv, lava yoki sigirdan soğib olingan sut bilan töldirişingiz mumkin!

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Ekin ekiş uçun yer maydonini tayyorlaşda ketmondan foydalaning.

source_string: Spiders won't attack you during the day - unless you attack them.
translation: Örgimçaklar kunduzi sizga tegmaydi — agar ularga özingiz birinçi bölib hujum qilmasangiz.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Hayvonlarga ovqat bersangiz, ular yöqolib ketmaydi. Ularni xavfsiz saqlaş uçun katak yoki ğov yasang.

source_string: Eating cooked food reduces hunger better than eating raw food.
translation: Pişirilgan ovqat xom ovqatga qaraganda oçlikni ança yaxşi qondiradi.

source_string: Craft torches to light up dark areas. Monsters lurk in the darkness!
translation: Qoronğu joylarni yoritiş uçun maş'allar yasang. Maxluqlar faqat zulmatda paydo böladi!

source_string: Get to destinations faster with a minecart and rail!
translation: Vagonetka va relslar yordamida manzilingizga tezroq yetib oling!

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Köçatlarni eking, ular tez orada daraxt bölib ösib çiqadi.

source_string: Pigmen won't attack you - unless you attack them.
translation: Zombilangan piglinlar sizga birinçi bölib hujum qilmaydi — albatta, ularga özingiz tegmasangiz.

source_string: You can change your game spawn point, and skip to dawn by sleeping in a bed.
translation: Karavotda uxlaş orqali qayta tiriliş nuqtasini özgartirişingiz va tunni ötkazib yuborişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Olovli şarlarni Ghast'ning öziga qaytarib urib yuboring!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension - The Nether.
translation: Portal quriş sizga boşqa olam — Netherga yöl oçadi.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Digging dirt with a shovel is much faster than using a pickaxe!
translation: Har bir iş uçun töğri iş qurolidan foydalaning! Tuproqni belkurak bilan qaziş çökiçga qaraganda ança tezroq!

source_string: If you can't find any coal for your torches, you can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.
translation: Maş'al uçun kömir topa olmasangiz, peçda yoğoçdan pista kömir yasaşingiz mumkin.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
translation: Töğri pastga yoki töğri tepaga qarab qaziş unçalik ham yaxşi fikr emas.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Suyak uni (skelet suyagidan yasaladi) öğit sifatida işlatiladi va ekinlarni bir zumda östiradi!

source_string: Creepers explode when they get close to you!
Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidian — suv lava manbaiga tuşganda hosil böladi.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Suv yoki lavaning manba bloki olib taşlansa, uning oqişi butunlay töxtaydi.

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Çaqirtoş Ghast'ning olov şarlariga çidamli, şu sababli u portallarni himoyalaş uçun juda mos keladi.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice. This includes torches, glowstones, and Jack-O-Lanterns.
translation: Yoruğlik manbai bölgan bloklar qor va muzni eritadi. Bunga maş'allar, yorqintoşlar va jek çiroqlari kiradi.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Oçiq havoda jundan inşootlar qurişda ehtiyot böling — çaqmoq urib, junni yoqib yuborişi mumkin.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Bitta lava çelagi bilan peçda 100 ta blokni eritiş mumkin.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: Nota bloki çiqaradigan çolğu ovozi uning ostidagi blok turiga boğliq.

source_string: Zombies and Skeletons can survive daylight if they are in water or wearing a helmet.
translation: Zombilar va skeletlar suvda bölişsa yoki dubulğa kiygan bölsa, kunduzi tirik qola oladi.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile and attack you. This trait is also shared by Zombie Pigmen.
translation: Bitta böriga qöl kötarsangiz, atrofida bölgan barça börilar duşmanga aylanadi. Zombilangan piglinlar ham xuddi şunday töda bölib hujum qiladi.

source_string: Wolves and Iron Golems won't attack Creepers.
translation: Börilar va temir golemlar creeper'larga hujum qilişmaydi.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Tovuqlar har 5–10 daqiqada bittadan tuxum qöyadi.

source_string: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidianni faqat olmos çökiç bilan qazib oliş mumkin.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creeper'lar — porox olişning eng oson yöli.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Ikkita sandiqni yonma‑yon qöyib ularni bitta katta sandiqqa aylantirsa böladi.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Xonakilaştirilgan börilarning qança joni qolganini dumining joylaşuvidan bilib olsa böladi. Ularni davolaş uçun göşt bering.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Har xil rangli böyoqlarni turli xil manbalardan oliş mumkin. Yaşil böyoqni oliş uçun peçda kaktusni pişiring!

source_string: On mobile devices, you can download the "Music by Minecraft" pack from the Music Category in the Minecraft Store.
translation: Mobil qurilmalarda Minecraft dökonining "Musiqa" bölimidan "Music by Minecraft" töplamini yuklab olişingiz mumkin.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Qölingizda buğdoy uşlab tursangiz, ba'zi hayvonlar orqangizdan ergaşib yuradi.

source_string: Gold is more abundant in Mesa biomes!
translation: Mesa biomida oltin boşqa biomlarga qaraganda ança köproq uçraydi!

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Dioritni yo çin dildan sevasiz, yo undan nafratlanasiz.
Odamlar rostdan ham uşbu maslahatlarni öqişarmikin-a?
Suziş uçun suvda yuguriş tugmasini bosing!

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: Girdob sehri yomğirli ob‑havoda sizni töğridan‑töğri osmonga uçirib yuboradi.

source_string: MINECON Earth is a worldwide interactive live-streaming event. Grab your items and join the party!
translation: MINECON Earth — butun dunyo böylab jonli efirda ötadigan interaktiv tadbirdir. Kerakli narsalaringizni oling-da, bizga qöşiling!

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a nether star from the Wither!
translation: Mayoq — ğoyat qudratli narsa, uni faqat Wither'dan tuşadigan Nether yulduzi bilan yasaş mumkin!

source_string: Did you know that nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions?
translation: Nether yulduzlarini portlatiş orqali yöq qilib bölmasligini bilarmidingiz?

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Tepaga qarab qaziyotganingizda, qulab tuşişi mumkin bölgan qum yoki şağalni birdan yöq qiliş uçun oyoq ostingizga maş'al qöying.
Piglinlar bilan oltin evaziga savdo qilişingiz mumkin

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey
translation: Asalari uyasi yoki arixonadan mum oliş uçun qayçidan, asal oliş uçun esa şişa idişdan foydalaning

source_string: Place a Campfire under a Beehive or nest to harvest honey peacefully. Your bees will thank you.
translation: Asalni tinçgina yiğib oliş uçun arixona yoki asalari uyasi ostiga gulxan yoqing. Arilar sizdan minnatdor bölişadi.

source_string: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged Respawn Anchor
translation: Nether'da qayta tiriliş uçun quvvatlangan qayta tiriliş langari kerak böladi.

source_string: You can charge a Respawn Anchor with Glowstone
translation: Qayta tiriliş langarini yorqintoş bilan quvvatlaşingiz mumkin

source_string: You can breed Hoglins with Crimson Fungus, but it is dangerous!
translation: Hoglinlarni qirmizi qöziqorin bilan köpaytirişingiz mumkin, ammo bu xavfli!
Ğoyangiz bormi? feedback.minecraft.net saytiga taşrif buyuring!

source_string: Allays can be found in Pillager Outposts and Woodland Mansions.
translation: Yuvoşlarni talonçilar avanpostlarida va örmondagi qasrlarda topiş mumkin.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: Yuvoşlar buyumlarni töplaşni juda yaxşi köradi! Agar unga biror buyum bersangiz, u öşa buyumdan köproq topib kelişga harakat qiladi.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with Noteblocks!
translation: Yuvoşlar musiqani juda yoqtirişgani uçun nota bloklari bilan bajonidil öynaşişadi!

source_string: Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Qadimiy şaharlarni toğ tizmalari ostidan topişingiz mumkin.

source_string: When wandering in Deep Dark, silence is key.
translation: Zulmat qa'rida kezganda, sukunat — eng muhim qoida.

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Loy oliş uçun tuproq blokiga suv şişasini işlating!

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Baqalar kiçik va kub şaklidagi moblarni yeydi.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Itbaliq ösib ulğaygan biomning haroratiga qarab öz turini tanlaydi.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
Need more smithing templates? Try to copy them.
translation: Köproq temirçilik şablonlari kerakmi? Ularni nusxalab köring.

source_string: The sniffer egg seems to like moss blocks.
translation: Hidlovçi tuxumiga yösin bloklari köproq yoqadiganga öxşaydi.

source_string: Mob heads make sounds, try them out on note blocks!
translation: Mob boşlari tovuş çiqaradi, ularni nota bloklariga qöyib sinab köring!

source_string: Some sand might be suspicious. Use your brush on it to find some good stuff!
translation: Ba'zi qumlar şubhali tuyulişi mumkin. Qiziqarli narsalarni topiş uçun unda çötkadan foydalaning!

source_string: Two players can ride together on a camel.
translation: Tuya ustida bir vaqtning özida ikkita öyinçi birgalikda minişi mumkin.

source_string: Show the direction of other players in multiplayer
translation: Birga öynaganda boşqa öyinçilarning yönalişini körsatadi

source_string: You have been idle for too long.
translation: Siz juda uzoq vaqt harakatsiz turdingiz.

source_string: The amount of camera shake caused by being hurt
translation: Zarar olganda kameraning qançalik darajada çayqalişini belgilaydi

source_string: Randomly respawn somewhere within this many blocks of where you died (max 128)
translation: Ölgan joyingizdan şu belgilangan blok radiusi oraliğida tasodifiy joyda qayta tirilasiz (maks. 128)

source_string: Create, build, and explore without limits. You can fly, have endless materials, and can’t be hurt by monsters.
translation: Çeksiz imkoniyatlar bilan yarating, quring va dunyoni kaşf eting. Siz uça olasiz, resurslaringiz tugamaydi va maxluqlar sizga zarar yetkaza olmaydi.

source_string: Explore a mysterious world where you build, collect, craft, and fight monsters.
translation: Quring, resusrlarni töplang, narsalar yasang va maxluqlarga qarşi kuraşib, sirli dunyoni kaşf eting.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn but deal less damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to 5 hearts.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo böladi, biroq kamroq zarar yetkazadi. Oçlik darajasi pasayib boradi va soğliqni 5 ta yurak qolgunça kamaytiradi.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn and deal standard damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to half a heart.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo böladi va odatiy darajada zarar yetkazadi. Oçlik darajasi pasayib boradi va soğliqni yarimta yurak qolgunça kamaytiradi.

source_string: No hostile mobs and only some neutral mobs spawn. Hunger bar doesn’t deplete and health replenishes over time.
translation: Yovuz moblar paydo bölmaydi, faqat ba'zi neytral moblarnigina uçratiş mumkin. Oçlik darajasi pasaymaydi, soğliq esa vaqt ötişi bilan qayta tiklanadi.
Maş'um alomat sinov yaratkiçini çulğab oldi
Maş'um alomat sinov yaratkiçini çulğab oldi

source_string: Copper Golem is placing an item
Piglin Brute converts to Zombified Piglin
The sound is too far away to be heard
%1$s died because not just the floor is lava
translation: %1$s lava faqat polda emasligini bilib oldi

translation: Bu bir neça daqiqa vaqt olişi mumkin
